sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

rows: [UNIT_CONVERSION] maximumExpectedRescueTime and survivalSupportDuration quantity constraints and comparison SPARQL: The required day unit is encoded as qudt:DAY, which expands to http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/DAY, but the locked canonical unit is http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/DAY. The same incorrect unit IRI is used in the SPARQL comparison, so valid canonical day quantities will not satisfy the shape or comparison. Required change: Bind the unit vocabulary namespace separately and replace every unit value qudt:DAY with http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/DAY, including both sh:hasValue constraints and the SPARQL unit matches.

[DATATYPE] gen:IMO_065_SurvivalResourcesShape / nltl:maximumExpectedRescueTime / qudt:numericValue and nltl:survivalSupportDuration / qudt:numericValue: Both quantity numeric values are restricted to xsd:decimal, although the canonical quantity properties have no decimal datatype requirement and valid whole-day values may be represented as xsd:integer; the SPARQL filter also rejects such values. Required change: Remove the xsd:decimal-only restrictions and exact decimal datatype filters, or explicitly support all valid numeric datatypes while retaining numeric comparison in days. | [CARDINALITY] gen:IMO_065_SurvivalResourcesShape / nltl:maximumExpectedRescueTime and nltl:survivalSupportDuration: The outer quantity properties have sh:minCount 1 but no sh:maxCount 1, so multiple rescue-time or support-duration quantities are permitted; the SPARQL constraint can then pass on one compliant value while another value changes the represented scalar requirement. Required change: Add sh:maxCount 1 to both outer quantity property shapes so each required duration is represented by exactly one quantity value.
